title: carex hudsonii f. humilis
intro: Carex hudsonii f. humilis, commonly known as Hudson's sedge, is a low-growing, perennial grass-like plant belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is used in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in alleviating symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and high blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Carex hudsonii f. humilis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
